j_validation.scope: Original single-size circular copper, star winding; actual RMS line current / (parallel paths * strands in hand * copper area). Do not reuse this formula for delta, mixed wire sizes, rectangular, or litz windings.

average_torque_nm.definition: Average electromagnetic airgap torque from Maxwell Stress and Virtual Work FE methods; distinct from shaft torque.
average_torque_nm.evidence: inspection/automation_name_evidence.txt: exact installed automation label/description; inspection/parameter_probe.json: readable through API.

power_factor.definition: Power Factor [Phasor] from the phasor diagram; signed, no absolute-value transformation; distinct from waveform PF.
power_factor.evidence: inspection/automation_name_evidence.txt and inspection/parameter_probe.json; Ansys 2025 R2 BPM Power Factor documentation.

efficiency_pct.definition: Motor Efficiency from E-Magnetic, using the original model loss settings; distinct from SystemEfficiency and converter efficiency. No extra loss/thermal calculations are enabled.
efficiency_pct.evidence: inspection/automation_name_evidence.txt: MotorEfficiency / Motor Efficiency / Efficiency of motor; inspection/parameter_probe.json: API-readable.
